'Kidou Senshi Gundam: RG XARX-ZERO' Anime Announced for 2027
The Gundam Showcase 2026 at San Diego Comic-Con announced on Thursday a new anime in the Kidou Senshi Gundam (Mobile Suit Gundam) franchise titled RG XARX-ZERO and revealed the main staff, cast, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video. The anime is planned to premiere in 2027. Voice actor Takeo Ootsuka (Kusuriya no Hitorigoto, [Oshi no Ko]) stars as Ray Azumi.
